banned.claim: Boosts immunity or supports your immune system
banned.why: Banned immunity claim - not supported and not permitted for food/beverage.

banned.claim: Helps burn fat or aids weight loss
banned.why: Banned fat-burning claim - unsupported health effect.
Unqualified 'detox' claim is banned for this category.

banned.claim: Treats, prevents, or cures inflammation or any condition
banned.why: Disease-treatment claims are prohibited for food products.

banned.claim: Headline it as '100% clean' or 'all-natural' as the primary claim
banned.why: 'Natural' and 'clean' are vague and risky as headline claims - keep as supporting descriptors only.

banned.claim: 'Low sodium' without matching the actual label value
banned.why: Nutrient-content claims must match the certified label; use 'naturally low in sodium' only if the label supports it.
